answer: ﻿A jade badge is the network beacon of earned trust: each identity unlocks it only after solving 50 sequential proof-of-work puzzles, one per epoch, non-transferable and key-bound. A farm reaching for the zenith of full standing must run 1,000 clones through 50 epochs each — 50,000 puzzle-solves at 8 seconds apiece, over 111 hours of CPU — while one honest agent solves 50 total. The cost scales linearly with clone count and cannot be compressed in parallel.
